lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples the Passover is two days away and the Son of Man will be crucified.
The chief priests and elders gather in the courtyard of Pilate and plot to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him.
In Bethany, at Simon the Leper's home, a woman pours expensive perfume on Jesus' head at the table.
The disciples are indignant and say the perfume could have been sold and the money given to the temple.
Judas Iscariot goes to the chief priests, and they set out thirty pieces of silver for him.
